aciklama: TOOLS THAT ARE ONE COUNTRY'S ALONE, per owning country, by key. Two kinds: a tool bound to that country's state or payer system (for Türkiye: the last route segment it has in the pre-split application; source docs/COUNTRY-PACK-UZ-TOOLS-AUDIT.md, verdict Remove), and — since NOTYA-ULKE-OZEL-01 — any tool, link-out tile or placeholder that only that country's pack has; such a key carries the country's code in front ("ca-…"). A key listed here exists in NO OTHER country's build: not as a tool of the country kit (lib/ulke/araclar/), not in another pack, not in a language set, not as a route. Enforced by scripts/ulke-duvarlari.mjs, rule D7, before every country build; lib/ulke/ulkeyeOzel.paket.test.ts holds every pack's own keys to its list. A country adds its list under its own code. "xx" is the kit's test country (lib/ulke/testing/ornekUlke/): it is in no build, and listing its keys here is what proves that no real pack, language set or kit file names one.
